title: People in China Swim in Freezing River for Health, Happiness
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: From VOA Learning English, this is the Health & Lifestyle report.
sentences.zh: 从VOA学习英语, 这是健康和生活方式报告。

sentences.en: Even as temperatures kept dropping in China’s northeastern “ice city” of Harbin, excitement rose among a group of swimmers who enjoy jumping into freezing waters.
sentences.zh: 即使中国东北部哈尔滨“冰城”气温持续下降,

sentences.en: The daily event, known as ice swimming, is a winter tradition in Harbin.
sentences.zh: 每天的活动被称为冰游泳,是哈尔滨的一个冬季传统。

sentences.en: Swimmers train daily throughout the year to get their bodies ready for the unusual swim.
sentences.zh: 游泳者们全年每天训练 让他们的身体为不寻常的游泳做好准备

sentences.en: Reporters from The Associated Press recently visited the city and spoke with some of the swimmers.
sentences.zh: 美联社记者最近访问该市,与一些游泳者交谈。

sentences.en: To create a pool in the Songhua River, the swimmers first had to break a 10-centimeter thick cover of ice.
sentences.zh: 为了在宋华河上建一个游泳池,游泳者首先必须打破10厘米厚的冰层。

sentences.en: Then they removed the ice pieces, took off all clothes except bathing suits and prepared to enter.
sentences.zh: 然后他们取下冰块,脱掉除泳衣外的所有衣服,准备进入。

sentences.en: One by one, they jumped into a freezing, 10-meter-long pool.
sentences.zh: 他们一个接一个跳进一个冰冻的10米长的游泳池

sentences.en: Some of the swimmers reported that their legs and arms quickly went numb after entering the water.
sentences.zh: 一些游泳者报告说,他们的腿和胳膊在进入水中后很快麻木。

sentences.en: The outside temperature was about minus 13 degrees Celsius and the water temperature remained near freezing.
sentences.zh: 外部温度约为负13摄氏度,水温仍然接近冻结。

sentences.en: One of the swimmers was Chen Xia. She came from Zhejiang province about 1,700 kilometers further south.
sentences.zh: 其中一名游泳者是陈霞,她来自更南约1 700公里的浙江省。

sentences.en: She decided to jump into the river even though she had a cold.
sentences.zh: 她决定跳进河里 尽管她感冒了

sentences.en: Chen said the winter waters where she lives are warmer than those in Harbin.
sentences.zh: 陈说她居住的冬季水域 比哈尔滨的更温暖

sentences.en: She said the experience strengthened her confidence in winter swimming.
sentences.zh: 她说,经验加强了她对于冬季游泳的信心。

sentences.en: She has been taking part in the activity for about 20 years.
sentences.zh: 她参加了大约20年的活动。

sentences.en: The 56-year-old Chen said the freezing waters made her skin feel like small pins were attacking her body.
sentences.zh: 56岁的Chen说冰水使她的皮肤感觉像小针刺在攻击她的身体。

sentences.en: But, she added that the experience still brought her happiness. “I felt prickling all over my body.
sentences.zh: 但是,她补充说,经验仍然给她带来幸福。 “我感到全身充满刺痛。

sentences.en: But it still made me feel blissful, ” she said.
sentences.zh: ”她说。

sentences.en: Yu Xiaofeng lives in Harbin, a city that sits near the border with Russia.
sentences.zh: 于晓芬住在哈尔滨 与俄罗斯接壤的城市

sentences.en: The 61-year-old said winter swimming in the city dates back to the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 61岁的孩子说 冬天在城里游泳可以追溯到1970年代

sentences.en: At that time, locals saw Russian Orthodox religious believers being baptized in the river.
sentences.zh: 当时,当地人看到俄罗斯东正教信徒在河里接受洗礼。

sentences.en: Later in 1983, an official winter swimming group was established in Harbin.
sentences.zh: 1983年晚些时候,在哈尔滨成立了一个正式的冬季游泳队。

sentences.en: The city also holds an ongoing winter celebration known for its huge, detailed ice and snow sculptures.
sentences.zh: 该市还持续举行冬季庆祝活动,以其巨大的、详细的冰雪雕塑著称。

sentences.en: Winter swimming is considered a sport in China.
sentences.zh: 冬季游泳在中国被视为一项运动。

sentences.en: But it gained popularity much faster in Harbin than in other parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 但是在哈尔滨,它的受欢迎程度比全国其他地区要快得多。

sentences.en: Today, Yu said the city is considered a “holy land” for winter swimming.
sentences.zh: 今天,优说,这个城市被认为是冬季游泳的“圣地”。

sentences.en: Yu said the winter swimmers appear to have better health than others.
sentences.zh: 优说冬天游泳的人比别人健康多了

sentences.en: She added that she has felt a great sense of family and joy in the community during her 30 years of winter swimming.
sentences.zh: 她补充说,在她30年的冬季游泳期间,她感到了极大的家庭意识和在社区中的快乐。

sentences.en: While the AP reporters did not quote medical experts for this story, some of the swimmers said they believe ice swimming is good for their health.
sentences.zh: 虽然美联社记者没有引用医学专家的说法, 有些游泳者说他们相信 冰游泳对他们健康有好处。

sentences.en: During the COVID-19 pandemic, the group even came up with a new saying to describe the experience.
sentences.zh: 在COVID-19大流行期间,该团体甚至提出了一个新的说法来描述这一经历。

sentences.en: They would rather “suffer through winter swimming than line up at the hospital,” Yu said.
sentences.zh: 他们宁愿“渡过冬季游泳,

sentences.en: You Decang is a 76-year-old winter swimmer who said he believes the activity helps keep him healthy.
sentences.zh: 你德刚是个76岁的冬季游泳者 说他相信这个活动能让他保持健康

sentences.en: He noted that he has never caught a cold.
sentences.zh: 他指出,他从未感冒。

sentences.en: You added, “If I go just one day without winter swimming, I feel quite uncomfortable .” And that’s the Health & Lifestyle report.
sentences.zh: 你又说 : “ 如果我一天不游泳,我就会感到很不舒服。 ”这是《健康与生活方式》报告。

sentences.en: I’m Anna Matteo. Andy Wong reported this story for The Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 我是Anna Matteo, Andy Wong为美联社报导此事。

sentences.en: Olivia Zhang and Caroline Chen contributed to this report.
sentences.zh: Olivia Zhang和Caroline Chen为本报告作出了贡献。

sentences.en: Anna Matteo adapted it for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: Anna Matteo改编成VOA英文学习版。
